name: Wheat bread (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Wheat bread [Cereals and cereal products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FDC 172687 (Bread, wheat, toasted) - amino-acid profile, scaled to 10.7 g protein
Aponte et al. 2022, LAB & yeasts in sourdough, PMC9524358 (organic-acid qualitative)
Chemical & Nutritional Characterization of Sourdoughs, PMC12385715 (lactic 5.45-7.08 mg/g; acetic 0.64 mg/g)
Characteristics of new sourdough using LAB and wild yeast (Fortune Journals) - straight-dough lactic 97-108 mg/kg dry
FDA 21 CFR 184.1221 - calcium propionate GRAS preservative use levels
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a microbe on this medium are STARCH (36.3 g/100g, needs amylolysis) plus free glucose+fructose+maltose (~5.7 g/100g total). Organic acids - the main FooDB omission - are modest in standard yeast-leavened wheat bread (lactic ~0.01 g/100g) but rise 20-70x in sourdough (0.5-0.7 g/100g); propionic acid is present as an added preservative in most commercial loaves. Amino-acid pattern is gluten-typed (glutamate and proline dominant, lysine/methionine limiting).
curation_added: lactic acid (dominant organic acid, was absent)
quantitative free sugars (glucose 1.66, fructose 2.33, maltose 1.74 g/100g)
starch amount (36.3 g/100g, dominant carbon source)
full amino-acid amounts incl. Phe, Val, Trp (missing from record)
sodium 473 mg/100g and full quantitative mineral panel
quantitative vitamin panel (B1/B2/B3/B5/B6, folate, E, K)

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: Animal sterol; USDA measures 0 mg in wheat bread. FooDB predicted/implausible for a plant/cereal food.

curation_removed.name: Cyanocobalamin
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin B12 = 0 µg (USDA); cereals contain no B12. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed vitamin A = 0 µg (USDA); no animal-derived retinol in plain wheat bread.

curation_removed.name: Lactose C12H22O11
curation_removed.reason: Lactose = 0 g (USDA); no dairy sugar in basic wheat bread (only in milk breads).

curation_removed.name: Eicosapentaenoic acid
curation_removed.reason: Marine omega-3 (20:5 n-3); USDA lists 0.004 g trace, biologically implausible as a bread nutrient. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive trace/contaminant element, not a defined growth nutrient of bread.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt ion trace; only nutritionally relevant via B12, which is absent. Non-quantified FooDB trace.

curation_removed.name: Nonanoate
curation_removed.reason: C9:0 odd-chain FA not measured in USDA bread panel; FooDB predicted trace, not a real lipid component.

curation_removed.name: Heptanoate
curation_removed.reason: C7:0 odd-chain FA absent from USDA panel; FooDB predicted trace.

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
